# fabric-query-1 golden cases. Each `>>>` request is answered by `<<<`, byte for byte, by the in-memory source (test_protocol) and by the directory store
# (test_protocol_store). `@@@ source <canvas|journal|both>` and `@@@ policy <json>` stay in force until changed. Refresh the `<<<` lines with
# `test_protocol --update`, then READ each one against docs/DESIGN.md "Protocol (W3a)" before committing.
@@@ source canvas
# info: ops, the policy in force, shapes and orders; `at` counts the streams and records
>>> {"op":"info","id":1}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"info","id":1,"at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"ops":["info","streams","since"],"policy":{"streams":{"default":100,"max":1000},"since":{"default":200,"max":2000},"maxResponseBytes":1048576,"maxRequestBytes":65536,"unknownFields":"echo"},"shapes":["journal-1","canvas-event-1"],"orders":["seq","lamport"]}
# streams: ordered by writer, `next` a place
>>> {"op":"streams","id":"s1"}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"streams","id":"s1","at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"entries":[{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a","shape":"canvas-event-1","order":"lamport","records":4},{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-b","shape":"canvas-event-1","order":"lamport","records":4}],"next":null}
>>> {"op":"streams","limit":1}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"streams","at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"entries":[{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a","shape":"canvas-event-1","order":"lamport","records":4}],"next":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"}}

<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"streams","at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"entries":[{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-b","shape":"canvas-event-1","order":"lamport","records":4}],"next":null}
>>> {"op":"streams","cursor":{"namespace":"proj"}}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":false,"op":"streams","error":{"code":"bad-cursor","field":"cursor","message":"the cursor is not a place {\"namespace\":..,\"writer\":..}"}}

# a response stops once its entries reach maxResponseBytes: here after the third entry
@@@ policy {"maxResponseBytes":600}
>>> {"op":"since"}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"since","at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"entries":[{"writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"},"seq":1,"shape":"canvas-event-1","record":{"kind":"item.put@1","writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"},"lamport":1,"subject":"item-1","time":"2026-11-24T10:00:01Z","payload":{"title":"alpha","n":1}}},{"writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-b"},"seq":1,"shape":"canvas-event-1","record":{"kind":"item.put@1","writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-b"},"lamport":2,"subject":"item-3","time":"2026-11-24T10:00:02Z","payload":{"title":"beta"}}},{"writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"},"seq":2,"shape":"canvas-event-1","record":{"kind":"item.state@1","writer":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"},"lamport":3,"subject":"item-1","time":"2026-11-24T10:00:03Z","payload":{"state":"done"}}}],"next":{"format":"cursor-1","positions":[{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a","position":2},{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-b","position":1}]},"more":true}
# unknownFields: reject names the first
@@@ policy {"unknownFields":"reject"}
>>> {"op":"info","second":1,"first":2}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":false,"op":"info","error":{"code":"unknown-field","field":"second","message":"this request has a member that 'info' does not take"}}
# unknownFields: ignore answers as if the members were absent
@@@ policy {"unknownFields":"ignore"}
>>> {"op":"streams","limit":1,"second":1,"first":2}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":true,"op":"streams","at":{"streams":2,"records":8},"entries":[{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a","shape":"canvas-event-1","order":"lamport","records":4}],"next":{"namespace":"proj","writer":"w-a"}}
# a request over maxRequestBytes is refused before it is parsed
@@@ policy {"maxRequestBytes":40}
>>> {"op":"since","limit":3,"note":"this request is longer than forty bytes"}
<<< {"schema":"fabric-query-1","ok":false,"error":{"code":"too-large","field":"","message":"the request is 73 bytes; the limit is 40"}}
@@@ policy {}
@@@ source journal
